root: 古英语 hwa（谁）+ aefre（任何时候）在中古英语合写，十六世纪起成为单词 whoever；同族有 whomever、whatever、whenever。

sensesIntro.en: The word takes an open question and closes it for every possible answer, then moves from the subject of a clause to a role anyone could fill.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词把开放的提问对所有可能的答案一律关上，再从从句主语移向谁都能填的角色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open door with the light on, a name still blank.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇开着的门、亮着的灯，名字仍空着。

branches.en: The open-door branch: whoever arrives first turns on the lights.
branches.cn: 开门分支：无论谁先到都把灯打开。

branches.en: The blame branch: whoever left the tap running.
branches.cn: 责任分支：不管是谁没关水龙头。

branches.en: The surprise branch: whoever told you that.
branches.cn: 惊讶分支：说那话的究竟是谁。

branches.en: The role branch: the key goes to whoever is on duty.
branches.cn: 角色分支：钥匙交给值班的那个人。

branches.en: The any-person branch: anyone, spoken plainly.
branches.cn: 任一分枝：也就是平常说的任何人。

intro.en: Whoever is a compound of the question stem who and the free word ever, and the second half is what carries the meaning of any and no matter.
intro.cn: whoever 是疑问词干 who 与自由词 ever 的复合，后半部分才承载「任何」「不管」的意思。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are native Germanic, so there is no Latin source; the Latin entries below offer the closest parallel expressions.
latinIntro.cn: 前后两半都是本土日耳曼词，没有拉丁语来源；下面的拉丁条目给出最接近的对应说法。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 whatever 与 whenever。

items.example: It stands as one word in modern use.
items.exampleCN: 现代用法中它是一个词。

items.meaning: the person who may want it

latinEntries.example: It is built from quis plus -cumque, the same doubling.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 它由 quis 加 -cumque 构成，是同一种叠加。

definition_zh: 分类；归类；类别；（图书等）分类体系
definition_en: the act of putting things into groups, a group formed in this way, or the system used for grouping them
core_image: 抽屉里按标签分格、贴好编号的标本
scene: 标本柜的抽屉上贴着标签，从门到科排得整整齐齐。 The classification of these plants took years.
sceneCN: 这里 classification 指「分类」（第 1 个义项：把事物按共同特征归入各组）；句意是给这些植物分类花了好几年。

pos.zh: 分类；归类；类别；分类体系

senses.title: The act of sorting
senses.definition: the act of arranging things into groups according to shared features
senses.definitionCN: 按共同特征把事物归入各组的动作
senses.example: The classification of the finds took a whole winter.
senses.exampleCN: 给这些出土物分类花了整整一个冬天。
senses.why: The noun of action simply names what the verb classify does.
senses.whyCN: 这个动作名词直接指 classify 这个动词所做的事。

senses.title: A group produced by sorting
senses.definition: one of the groups that result from sorting things
senses.definitionCN: 分类之后形成的其中一组
senses.example: These tools fall into a separate classification.
senses.exampleCN: 这些工具属于另一个类别。
senses.why: Once the sorting is finished, each box in the result takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 分类完成后，结果中的每一个格子也叫同一个名字。

senses.title: A system of groups
senses.definition: the whole scheme by which a subject is divided into ordered groups
senses.definitionCN: 把某学科划分成有序各组的整套方案
senses.example: The library uses a simple classification.
senses.exampleCN: 这家图书馆采用一套简单的分类法。
senses.why: A set of related groups becomes a system, and the system keeps the name of the act.
senses.whyCN: 相关的各组构成体系，而这个体系仍沿用那个动作的名称。

intro.en: Classification joins the class root to the Latin suffix for making a noun of action.
intro.cn: classification 把 class 词根与拉丁语构成动作名词的后缀结合起来。

items.en: Classis meant a division or a class.
items.cn: classis 意为划分或等级。

items.en: Facere meant to make, so the pair meant to make groups.
items.cn: facere 意为做，两者合起来意为做出分组。

items.en: Classification named the new science of sorting plants.
items.cn: classification 指新兴的植物分类之学。

items.en: English borrowed the word for any ordered grouping.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，指任何有序分组。

items.en: It now covers library systems, jobs and secret files.
items.cn: 它如今涵盖图书系统、职位与机密文件。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the classify family, while the meaning group names the results of sorting.
note.cn: 形近组列出 classify 家族，近义组列出分类的结果。

entries.definition: to arrange things into groups
a person or tool that sorts things
entries.definitionCN: 给事物分类的人或工具

entries.definition: arranged in groups, or officially secret
entries.definitionCN: 已分组的，或官方保密的

entries.definition: a group of things of one kind
a set of things placed together
the act of arranging things by kind
entries.definitionCN: 按种类整理事物的动作

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the class root, the -ification ending and the library image.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 class 词根、-ification 后缀与图书馆意象。

normal.en: Classification is class plus -ification, so it is literally the making of classes.
normal.cn: classification 是 class 加 -ification，字面上就是造出类别。

normal.en: The word names three things in turn: the act, one resulting group and the whole system.
normal.cn: 这个词依次指三样东西：动作、一个结果组以及整套体系。

normal.en: Biology lives on classification, from kingdom down to species.
normal.cn: 生物学离不开分类，从界一直到种。

normal.en: A classified document is not sorted; it is marked secret.
normal.cn: a classified document 不是分好类的文件，而是标为机密的文件。

normal.en: The verb is classify, the doer is classifier, the result is classification.
normal.cn: 动词是 classify，执行者是 classifier，结果是 classification。

abstract.en: Picture a cabinet of drawers, each with a printed label and a number.
abstract.cn: 想象一个抽屉柜，每个抽屉都贴着打印标签和编号。

abstract.en: Picture a pile of leaves sorted into two trays by shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆叶子按形状分进两个托盘。

abstract.en: Picture a library shelf where every spine carries the same small code.
abstract.cn: 想象图书馆书架，每本书脊上都有同样的小编码。

examples.en: The classification of the finds took a whole winter.
examples.cn: 给这些出土物分类花了整整一个冬天。

examples.en: These tools fall into a separate classification.
examples.cn: 这些工具属于另一个类别。

examples.en: The library uses a simple classification for all its maps.
examples.cn: 这家图书馆对所有地图采用一套简单的分类法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 class 想成「类」，ification 想成「化过程」：把东西归成类的过程，就是分类。

root: 由拉丁语 classis（划分）与 facere（做）组合而成，经法语进入英语，本义是做出分组。

sensesIntro.en: First the act, then a single group, and finally the whole ordered system.
sensesIntro.cn: 先指动作，再指单个组，最后指整套有序体系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: labelled drawers holding sorted specimens.
core.cn: 核心意象：贴着标签、装好分类标本的抽屉。

branches.en: The act of sorting is the first meaning.
branches.cn: 分类这个动作是第一层含义。

branches.en: Each finished group takes the same name.
branches.cn: 每个分好的组也叫同一个名字。

branches.en: The set of groups becomes a system.
branches.cn: 各组汇合起来成为体系。

branches.en: The act and its result differ only by a finished edge.
branches.cn: 动作与结果只差一个完成的边界。

branches.en: Groups become a system once their order is fixed.
branches.cn: 各组一旦固定次序就成了体系。

intro.en: The noun base grows a verb, two adjectives and an agent noun.
intro.cn: 这个名词词基长出动词、两个形容词与一个施动名词。

latinIntro.en: The base joins Latin classis, a division, with facere, to make.
latinIntro.cn: 词基把拉丁语 classis（划分）与 facere（做）结合起来。

items.meaning: the act or result of sorting
more than one category or system

items.example: We classify the rocks by origin.
items.exampleCN: 我们按成因给岩石分类。

items.meaningCN: 已分类的，或标为机密的

items.meaning: a person or device that sorts

items.example: Each class has its own label.
items.exampleCN: 每一类都有自己的标签。

latinEntries.exampleCN: classis 是 classification 的开头。

definition_zh: 喷气式飞机；喷射；喷嘴；（液体或气体的）一股
definition_en: a fast aircraft driven by jet engines, or a strong narrow stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening
core_image: 一股水从细口喷出，笔直射得很远
scene: 机场跑道上一架飞机加速，机尾拉出一条长烟。 The jet climbed into the clouds within a minute.
sceneCN: 这里 jet 是「喷气式飞机」（第 1 个义项：靠喷气发动机高速飞行的飞机），句意为一分钟内那架喷气机就爬升进了云层。画面里的物件：跑道、机尾的烟、云层。

pos.zh: 名词：喷气式飞机；喷射；喷嘴；一股
动词：乘喷气机飞行；喷出
形容词：喷气式的；乌黑发亮的

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转形容词，义为「喷出的；乘喷气机旅行的」
由 jet 加 -ing 构成，义为「喷射」
与 jet 同源的借词，义为「突堤；码头」

senses.title: A stream forced out
senses.definition: a strong narrow stream of liquid or gas pushed out of a small opening
senses.definitionCN: 从细口被压出的一股强而窄的液体或气体
senses.example: A jet of steam rose from the kettle.
senses.exampleCN: 水壶里喷出一股蒸汽。
senses.why: The stream sense is the oldest, from a French verb meaning to throw out.
senses.whyCN: 射流义最古老，来自法语里表示「抛出」的动词。

senses.title: The nozzle itself
senses.definition: the small opening or pipe through which such a stream comes out
senses.definitionCN: 喷出这股流的细口或管子
senses.example: Clean the jet under the tap.
senses.exampleCN: 在水龙头下把喷嘴冲干净。
senses.why: The opening is named by what comes out of it, a common shift in English.
senses.whyCN: 开口借由从它出来的东西得名，这是英语里常见的转义。

senses.title: An engine that pushes by gas
senses.definition: an engine that produces forward thrust by forcing hot gas backward
senses.definitionCN: 把高温气体向后喷出来获得推力的发动机
senses.example: The jet of the plane roared during take-off.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机起飞时喷气发动机轰鸣起来。
senses.why: The machine works exactly by making a jet, so the word names engine and aircraft together.
senses.whyCN: 这台机器正是靠制造射流工作，于是这个词同时指发动机和飞机。

senses.title: An aircraft with such engines
senses.definition: a plane driven by jet engines, especially a fast passenger plane
senses.definitionCN: 由喷气发动机驱动的飞机，尤指快速客机
senses.example: They took a jet to the coast for the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 他们周末坐喷气机去了海边。
senses.why: In everyday speech jet means the plane itself, the machine standing for the whole object.
senses.whyCN: 日常语里 jet 就指飞机本身，机器代指了整个物件。

senses.title: Deep glossy black
senses.definition: used before a colour word, especially black, for a deep shining shade
senses.definitionCN: 用在颜色词前，尤其 black，表示深沉发亮的颜色
senses.example: Her hair was jet black in the light.
senses.exampleCN: 她的头发在光下乌黑发亮。
senses.why: The dark shiny lignite called jet gave this colour sense through stone jewellery.
senses.whyCN: 一种叫 jet 的乌黑光亮褐煤，通过石饰带来了这个颜色义。

intro.en: Jet for a stream comes from French jeter, "to throw", from Latin jactare; the black stone jet is a separate word.
intro.cn: 表示射流的 jet 来自法语 jeter「投掷」，其根是拉丁语 jactare；乌黑的宝石 jet 则是另一个词。

items.en: jactare meant to throw or toss repeatedly.
items.cn: jactare 意为反复投掷、抛。

items.en: jeter meant to throw or cast.
items.cn: jeter 意为投、抛。

items.en: English formed jet as the stream thrown out.
items.cn: 英语造出 jet，指被抛出的那一股。

items.en: jet came to name the nozzle and later the pushing action of gas.
items.cn: jet 先指喷嘴，后来指气体向后推的动作。

items.en: The jet engine gave the word its aircraft sense.
items.cn: 喷气发动机给了这个词「飞机」义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the jet- family; the near-meaning group holds words for planes and streams.
note.cn: 形近组是 jet- 词族；近义组收飞机与射流相关词。

entries.definition: A structure built out into the water.
entries.definitionCN: 与 jet 同源的名词，义为「突堤；码头」。

entries.definition: Sprayed out, or travelled by jet.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「喷出的；乘喷气机的」。

entries.definition: The act of sending out a stream.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「喷射」，同族名词。

entries.definition: Any flying machine, with or without jet engines.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「飞机」，最中性的统称。

entries.definition: Liquid scattered in fine drops.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「喷雾」，比 jet 更散。

entries.definition: A continuous flow of liquid or gas.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「流」，比 jet 更宽、更连续。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the throwing verb into nozzles and airports, keeping the black stone apart.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从「投掷」的动词走到喷嘴和机场，并把乌黑宝石那条线分开。

normal.en: French jeter means to throw.
normal.cn: 法语 jeter 意为投、抛。

normal.en: Latin jactare means to toss about.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 jactare 意为反复抛掷。

normal.en: A jet of water shoots from a small hole.
normal.cn: 一股水从小孔射出。

normal.en: A jet engine pushes gas backward to go forward.
normal.cn: 喷气发动机把气体向后喷以获得向前的推力。

normal.en: Jet black comes from the shiny black stone jet.
normal.cn: jet black 来自乌黑光亮的宝石 jet。

abstract.en: A jet is a narrow line of liquid that refuses to spread.
abstract.cn: 射流是一道拒绝散开的窄线。

abstract.en: What pushes gas back is pushed forward.
abstract.cn: 往后推气的东西自己被往前推。

abstract.en: A stream and a stone share a spelling but not a history.
abstract.cn: 一股流与一块宝石拼写相同，来历却不同。

examples.en: A jet of hot water hit the wall.
examples.cn: 一股热水冲到了墙上。

examples.en: The jet crossed the Atlantic in six hours.
examples.cn: 这架喷气机六小时飞越大西洋。

examples.en: She wore a jet black dress.
examples.cn: 她穿了一条乌黑的裙子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「急特」—— 气急急地特快一喷，飞得又高又快

root: 拉丁语 jactare「反复投掷」→ 古法语 jeter「投、抛」→ 英语 jet「射流；喷嘴」→ 喷气发动机与喷气机。乌黑宝石 jet 另出一源。同族有 jetted、jetting、jetty。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: a forced stream, the nozzle, a jet engine, a jet aircraft, and deep glossy black.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：被压出的射流、喷嘴、喷气发动机、喷气式飞机，以及乌黑发亮的颜色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hard straight line of water shot from a small hole.
core.cn: 核心意象：从细孔射出的又直又硬的一股水。

branches.en: THE KETTLE: steam hissing out of a hole.
branches.cn: 水壶这条线：蒸汽从孔里嘶出来。

branches.en: THE TAP: a small nozzle rinsed clean.
branches.cn: 水龙头这条线：冲干净的喷嘴。

branches.en: THE RUNWAY: roaring gas lifting a plane.
branches.cn: 跑道这条线：轰鸣的气体把飞机抬起来。

branches.en: THE LIGHT: shining black hair.
branches.cn: 光这条线：乌黑发亮的头发。

branches.en: THE JEWELLER: the same black stone sold in a shop window.
branches.cn: 珠宝商这条线：橱窗里出售的同一块黑石。

intro.en: Jet is a French borrowing from a Latin verb of throwing; English added the verb endings and compounds.
intro.cn: jet 是古法语借来的词，源头为拉丁语「投掷」动词，英语补上动词词尾与复合。

latinIntro.en: Latin jactare, an intensified form of jacere, supplies the stem behind the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 jactare（jacere 的加强形式）提供了这个词背后的词干。
